analysis.subject: physics
analysis.pageCoverage: The page covers fluid dynamics, characteristics of gases and molecules, macro scale measurable properties and micro scale kinetic theory, density, diffusion and convection, rotational flow, viscosity with boundary layer, and compressibility with shock waves.

overview.headline: Large-scale and molecular views of gas motion and flow effects

keyPoints.point: Students learn that large scale motion defines the macro scale while individual molecular motions define the micro scale.
keyPoints.quote: Scientists refer to the large-scale motion of the gas as the macro scale and the individual molecular motions as the micro scale.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that density is mass per volume of a substance.
keyPoints.quote: Density is the mass per volume of a substance.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that diffusion occurs when properties are transported by random motion.
keyPoints.quote: If the properties are transported by the random motion, the process is called diffusion.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that viscosity makes gas molecules stick to a surface and form a boundary layer.
keyPoints.quote: Gas molecules stick to any surface, creating a layer of air near the surface (called a boundary layer)

keyPoints.point: Students learn that beyond the speed of sound at about 700 mph shock waves affect lift and drag.
keyPoints.quote: Near and beyond the speed of sound (about 700 mph), shock waves are produced that affect both the lift and drag of an object.

keyTerms.gloss: Large-scale motion of gas that is averaged and measured as velocity, pressure, or temperature
keyTerms.quote: Scientists refer to the large-scale motion of the gas as the macro scale and the individual molecular motions as the micro scale.

keyTerms.gloss: Model using kinetic theory to describe tiny molecules in constant random motion
keyTerms.quote: On the micro scale, a gas is modeled by the kinetic theory.

keyTerms.gloss: Measure of mass per volume for molecules that move freely
keyTerms.quote: Because the molecules are free to move about in a gas, the mass of the gas is normally characterized by the density.

keyTerms.gloss: Properties carried by random motion of molecules
keyTerms.quote: If the properties are transported by the random motion, the process is called diffusion.

keyTerms.gloss: Properties carried by ordered motion of the bulk fluid
keyTerms.quote: If the properties are transported by the ordered motion, the process is called convection.

keyTerms.gloss: Stickiness of gas that causes molecules to cling to surfaces and form layers
keyTerms.quote: As an object moves through a gas, the viscosity (stickiness) of the gas becomes very important.

componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Helps students contrast large-scale measurable behavior with molecular kinetic behavior using page language.
componentPlan.focusQuote: Scientists refer to the large-scale motion of the gas as the macro scale and the individual molecular motions as the micro scale.

componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Reinforces checkable facts about density, boundary layer, and compressibility with exact speeds from the text.
componentPlan.focusQuote: If the object passes at a low speed (typically less than 200 mph), the density of the fluid remains constant.
